confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are triangulated from cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, NomadRanker, CostLiving) and Numbeo-based national averages, converted at roughly 3.8 PLN per USD. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because no direct figures were found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. The FX observation was taken from RBA search-result snippets and may be provisional, since the RBA publishes end-of-day rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Polish city priced below Warsaw and in line with other Polish regional cities. Food and drink use Poznań-specific sites where available and national Numbeo averages otherwise. Accommodation uses general knowledge of Polish regional hostel and hotel rates.
